serviceDescription: Steel Patriot Partners is a cybersecurity and data governance advisory firm that helps cloud service providers and their customers navigate FedRAMP. We advise organizations on FedRAMP readiness, authorization strategy, security control implementation, continuous monitoring, and data governance so they can achieve and maintain FedRAMP authorization efficiently.
contactInformation: Contact: Doug Stonier, Director of Compliance

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Gap assessments, readiness reviews, and advisory support to prepare cloud service offerings for FedRAMP authorization.
Guidance on implementing and documenting the security and privacy controls required for FedRAMP authorization.
Advisory support for maintaining FedRAMP authorization, including continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and reporting.
Advisory services for establishing data governance, data protection, and compliance practices aligned to federal security requirements.
